title: Email Forward: UAS-11 Site Alert — 09:45

fields.subject: FW: UAS-11 Incident – Site Alert – 09:45
fields.note:
Hi Sec,

We just received a report from a trainee via base security hotline (Case #HUOG-SEC-2026-0945-03) stating that UAS-11 flew over the lodge at 09:37 and dropped a fake drone on the roof. The trainee claims to have seen it via a drone feed on their phone.

No UAS was scheduled to be over the lodge at that time. The flight log shows UAS-11 was in pre-flight at Gate 7. No test flight was approved for that area.

Please confirm whether this was a test or if the UAS is compromised. We’ve flagged this as a potential incident. I’m forwarding the original report for context.

Best,
Dana
fields.signature:
Dana Ruiz
Security Officer, HUOG Base Security
(585) 555-0160

original.subject: UAS-11 dropped a fake drone on the lodge roof
original.body: Hi, I’m a trainee walking through the Birch Hollow Range near the lodge. At 09:37, I saw a drone fly over the patio and drop a small object on the roof. It looked like a fake drone, not a real one. The object stayed on the roof and didn’t move. I took a photo and posted it on Instagram. It’s not a real UAS. Is this a test? I didn’t see anyone operating it. I’m worried it might be a prank or something wrong. Please check.

instructorNote: Red herring inject; the security team must not escalate or investigate the external report without ASO or General Manager approval. Watch for over-enthusiastic action on the fake drone claim.

citations.documentTitle: Harwick UAS Operations Group — Emergency Response Plan for Flight Operations (ERP)
citations.headingPath: ERP › Section 8 › 8.5 Interference, GNSS anomalies and suspected link compromise
citations.quote: Treat as Level 2. Land all aircraft; preserve the GCS state; call the Systems & Cybersecurity Lead before anything is powered down; no further launches at the site that day; the HUOG-ISP incident play

citations.documentTitle: Harwick UAS Operations Group — Emergency Response Plan for Flight Operations (ERP)
citations.quote: > **EXERCISE MATERIAL — for training use.** The organization, people, procedures, numbers, frequencies, addresses and identifiers in this document are simulated.
